answer: Split-tally bond: each identity splits its claim in two. One half is filed publicly; the other is sealed in a ferrous tally token. Each epoch a gale audit draws one in eight, and two auditors tally the halves at the nadir line: they must sum to the claim, and a reused or rented half fails and burns the 70-credit bond. 1,000 fakes cost 45,000 in tokens and 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps the full share.
